source.prompt: Future bass song, about 3.5 minutes, 150 BPM, G major. Bright, bouncy and euphoric, a windswept open-sky feeling. Duet between a clear female lead and a warm male lead, trading lines in the verses and singing the chorus together in stacked harmonies. Big brass and string section chords with sidechained swells, glockenspiel and marimba plucks, pizzicato strings, warm finger bass. Half-time drums: punchy kick, heavy snare on beat 3, rolling hi-hats with fast fills. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Oh, oh, oh

[Verse]
Paper and colour, tied to my hand
Running the ridge where the green meets the sand
You said the wind only answers the brave
So I gave it my name and I gave it a wave

[Pre-Chorus]
Pull, pull, the sky is pulling too
Every little knot was holding me from you

[Chorus]
Let the line go, let the line go
Watch how high a heart can climb
Let the line go, let the line go
We'll be flying right on time
Up where the blue is wide and slow
Let the line go, let the line go

[Verse]
Sun on the shoulders, salt in the air
Two little shadows that vanish up there
All of the reasons I carried for years
Got smaller and smaller and turned into cheers

[Pre-Chorus]
Pull, pull, the sky is pulling too
Every little knot was holding me from you

[Chorus]
Let the line go, let the line go
Watch how high a heart can climb
Let the line go, let the line go
We'll be flying right on time
Up where the blue is wide and slow
Let the line go, let the line go

[Bridge]
Open your hand, open your hand
Nothing to hold and nowhere to land
Open your hand, I'm right here with you
Nothing above us but blue

[Chorus]
Let the line go, let the line go
Watch how high a heart can climb
Let the line go, let the line go
We'll be flying right on time
Up where the blue is wide and slow
Let the line go, let the line go
